ValidationRule.description: Validate how systemic issues may progress in the workflow.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( $Setup.Salesforce_Library_Settings__c.Disable_VRs__c = false, RecordType.DeveloperName = 'Systemic_Issue', !ISNew(), ISCHANGED(SI_Workflow_Step__c), IF( CASE(Text(PRIORVALUE(SI_Workflow_Step__c)), "1", CASE(Text(SI_Workflow_Step__c), "2", 1, "3",1, "4",1, 0), "2", CASE(Text(SI_Workflow_Step__c), "3", 1, "4",1, 0), "3", CASE(Text(SI_Workflow_Step__c), "2", 1, "4",1, 0), "4", CASE(Text(SI_Workflow_Step__c), "2", 1, 0), 1)=0, true, false ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: This is not a valid step change.
